ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominantly high-intensity (white) across approximately 75% of the surface area with low-intensity (black) pigmentation concentrated at the axial base and peripheral margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white regions occupy the medial and lateral zones of both lobes. A central low-intensity black geometric region is fixed at the fluke-peduncle junction. Numerous small (2-10 pixel diameter) low-intensity circular spots (mottling) are scattered bilaterally across the white regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression at the center; approximately 40-degree angle at the vertex with a moderate bounding-box depth relative to lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serrated boundary along the trailing edge of both lobes with vertical pixel-amplitudes ranging from 3 to 15 pixels, forming a high-frequency jagged profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilaterally symmetrical convex curves originating from the median notch and extending upwards toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dispersed low-intensity dark circular clusters (mottling) across the white ventral surface, with higher density clusters on the medial-lower section of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Short, diagonal low-intensity linear marks visible on the right lobe medial area and minor vertical disruptions on the left lobe near the trailing edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly irregular and jagged morphology of the distal tips (lobes' outer points) compared to standard smooth whale fluke profiles.
